set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- PreparedDirectNeighborhoodExecutor documentation states whether instances are thread-safe.
- Reusable coordinate arrays and workspaces have explicit ownership and lifetime rules.
- Concurrent use is either supported by isolated state or rejected deterministically.
- Immutable and mutable sources use one clear source contract with destination alias checks before writes.
- Repeated runs allocate only the documented workspace and result.
- JVM and Scala.js tests exercise reuse, alias rejection, and any supported concurrency behavior.
set.title: Specify prepared stencil ownership and thread-safety contracts
